name: table-guide-documentation
body:
The template-author reference (`docs/templates.md`, docs-templates) documents the `body.tables` option — its sub-keys `min_tables`, `max_tables`, `min_columns`, `max_columns`, `min_rows`, `max_rows` and `cell_attributes` — and the `cell_attributes` descriptors (`name`, `type`, enum `variants`), together with the cell-extension syntax (`{br}` and the `{…}` attribute groups, including the boolean and enum short-hands), and both embedded author guides (`AGENTS_KALIDE.md`, agent-authoring and library-agent-guide) carry the same, so an agent enables and uses tables without reading Go source. The build/test-time guide drift self-test (agent-guide-drift-check) carries the table tokens for both guides in the authored-scope style used for format keys with no canonical accessor (such as the section-declaration keys and the enum/image field keys).

AC: `docs/templates.md` documents the `tables` key, every sub-key and `cell_attributes`; both embedded author guides carry the `tables` key, its sub-keys and `cell_attributes`; removing a carried token from a guide fails the guide drift self-test.
